solution:
SELECT s.class, AVG(r.score)
FROM Student s JOIN Result r ON s.id = r.student_id
WHERE r.subject = 'Computing'
GROUP BY s.class HAVING AVG(r.score) >= 50
ORDER BY s.class;

steps.text: Select each class and its average score.
Match each result to its student.
Restrict the input rows to Computing.
Group by class and keep averages of at least 50.
